title: Curse of the Crimson Cutlass
description: During a raucous pirate-themed dinner show, the legendary Mapmaker Moss is murdered mid-performance. As the audience becomes suspects, hidden romances, financial desperation, and backstage betrayals surface in this swashbuckling night of intrigue and laughter.
core_plot: During the grand finale swordfight, Old Mapmaker Moss is stabbed with a real cutlass. The famous Treasure Map of Blackbeard’s Ghost vanishes.
motive_summary: Financial pressure, romantic jealousy, and fear of secrets being revealed.
twist_ending: The 'treasure map' is not about gold — it carries a warning: 'True treasure lies in the friends ye sail with.' Moss died protecting this message about loyalty.

captain.guilty: Moss was going to expose that I had been cutting corners with the props to save the show. I couldn’t let everything fall apart.
captain.innocent: This is ridiculous. I was in my dressing room counting the night’s ticket sales when it happened.

first_mate.guilty: Moss found out I was skimming merchandise money and threatened to ruin my chances of taking over. I had to protect my future.
first_mate.innocent: I was only trying to protect Lady Velvet and keep the show running smoothly.

cook.guilty: Moss kept insulting my cooking and flirting with Velvet. I lost control of the situation.
cook.innocent: I was stuck in the kitchen preparing the main course the whole time.

singer.guilty: Moss knew dangerous secrets from my past and was going to expose me. I had no choice but to silence him.
singer.innocent: I was performing on stage the entire time — everyone saw me.

treasure_hunter.guilty: The map was real and worth a fortune. Moss wouldn’t share the profits with me.
treasure_hunter.innocent: I was searching for the real treasure the whole time.

stagehand.guilty: They all treated me like I was nothing. Moss broke his promise to help me advance.
stagehand.innocent: I found the body first and panicked. I was just trying to help.

clues.clue_text: A torn piece of the treasure map with a distinctive compass rose stamp and the words 'Meet me at the crow’s nest – V'.
A crumpled betting slip in Moss’s pocket with large sums and the initial 'S'.
A broken prop sword hilt with a unique captain’s ring imprint and blue costume thread caught in it.
clues.importance: Points to someone with access to props.

accusation_phase: It’s time for accusations! We’ll go around one by one. State your character name clearly and tell us who you believe is the murderer and why.
reveal_phase: The murderer was… [Murderer Name]! Will the accused please stand and read your full confession to the group?
